content: Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ukleged
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sunmakded, ega sogded:
“Aarónʼga, degi, e-masmalaga be sogo: ‘Israel-dulemar anga ibmar-islidik-uksamaladgi melle dodomalo, adi, bemar mer an-nug-islidikid oichomalagar. Ani an Bab-Jehová gued.’

”Amarga be sogbalo: ‘Bela be-wagan, degi, be-wagan-sorba-danimarbaloed, nue-swilidiksuli-gudiidgi Israel-dulemar anga ibmar-islidikmalad-uksadse warmakdele, we-dule, an-asabin yog-onolegar guoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová gued.
” ’Aarón, ar be-wagan-gwensak naibe-buna-yaa nikale, igi, e-abgangi boni-nikale, na san-swilidik-guedse geb sunna Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-islidikmalad-ukleged gunnoed.
” ’Ar e-abgan enuksulile, a-dule, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-islidikmalad-ukleged gunnosulid.
Dad-argwatele, a-dule, swilidik gunonikoed. Geb a-sorba, Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-islidik-ukleged nabir gunnoed, ar ade, we-ibmar e-masgunned gued.
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad ibdurgan-burgwaled, degi, achu-sapurse ibdurgan-san-ichimaklesad gunnosulid. Ar degiile, dule swilidiksuli gunonikoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová gued.’ ”

Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Degisoggu, dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad an-igar-uknaidba ibsamalo. An-igar-uknaidba ibsasulid-ulale, melle isgumalo, adi, wemar melle burgwemalagar. Ani an Bab-Jehová, wemar angarbi-arbaega an nug-imaksad.
”Dule-irwa-Babse-goled-e-gargwenadsulid we-ibmar-islidikmalad gunnosulid. Deginbali, dule-e-neggi-maid, degi, dule-ega-arbaed, we-ibmar-islidikid gunnosurmarmogad.

”Ar dule-irwa-Babse-goled manigi mai-wargwen-baksale, a-duledi, sunna we-ibmar-islidikmalad gunnoed. Deginbali, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi mai-gwalulesmalad amba sunna we-ibmar-islidikid gunmarmogoed.
”Dule-irwa-Babse-goled-e-sisgwa, dule-irwa-Babse-goledsulidbo-nikusale, we-ome, Bab-Dummadga-we-ibmar-islidikid-ukleged gunnosulid.

Ar dule-irwa-Babse-goled-e-sisgwa ei-sui burgwenonidibe, mimmi-nikussuli e-sui-metedibe, na e-bab-negse gannar nonikile, ar igi yoo-sui-nikugu, e-bab-masgunned gundii gusa, deyobi, gannar e-bab-masgunned gundii gubaloed. Ar dule-baigandi, bipisaale we-mas gunnosulid.
”Ar dule-gwensak wissulidgi ibmar-islidikid guchale, we-dule, we-ibmar-guchad-wilub gannar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga ibmar ukoed. A-ukinbali, ibmar-atargi-gwensak napi ukbaloed.
”Degisoggu, dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad Israel-dulemar Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-islidikidmalad-ukleged-oichogega imakosulid.
Ar dule-wargwen, we-ibmar-islidikid-ukleged-guchale, na dukin e-isgued sedii guoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová, wemar angarbi-arbaega an nug-imaksad.”
Igid-ibdurgan Bab-Dummadga uklegoe
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga sogdebalid:
“Aarónʼga, degi, e-masmalaga, deginbali, bela Israel-dulemarga be sogo:
” ’Ibdurgan-wis-boni-nikad bipisaale Bab-Jehováʼga be ukosulid, ar ade, Bab-Jehová we-ibmar bei abingaosulid.

” ’Amba deyobbardo, ar dule-gwensak ibmar-imakoye-sogsad-ular, igi, na e-itoleged-ibmar-ukbied-ular, gwenatigwar-guega, Bab-Jehováʼga moli-bebe-nikad, sibad-wawaaddibe, sibaddibe, ukele, we-ibdurgan-swilidikid, boni-nikasulid ukoed, adi, nabir Bab-Jehová we-ibmar-uknaid abingaegar.
” ’Deginbali, we-ibmarmar ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi, Bab-Jehováʼga be ogumakar ukbalosulid.
Sunna be-itoleged ibmar-ukbiedba anga be moli-bebe-nikad, igi, sibad-wawaad-wis-bonigwaled uked. Ar ibmar-imakoye-sogsad-ular, ibdurgan-degiid be ukerdi, Bab-Jehová bei abingaosulid.
” ’Deginbali, ibdurgan-degimalad be-Bab-Jehováʼga-ukega, Israel-dulesulid-abin be abingabalosulid, ar ade, we-ibdurganmar bonigwaledid. Degisoggu, be-ibe abingalegosulid.’ ”
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga sogdebalid:

“Moli-bebe-nikad-e-mimmi gwalulesdibe, sibad-wawaad-e-mimmi-gwalulesdibe, igi sibad-e-mimmi-gwalulesdibe, na e-nan-walik ibagugle (7) gudii guoed. Geb ibabaabakgine (8) sunna bemar anga we-ibdurgan ogumakar ukoed.
”Melle iba-galagwena moli-bebe-nikad-ome, e-mimmi-ebo, igi, sibad-wawaad-ome, e-mimmi-ebo e-ibe be e-dukar egwanno.
”Be anga dog-nuedye-sogega, ibmar uknaile, nue igar-maidba-imakar be ukoed. Adi, an nabir abingaegar.
We-ibmar-be-anga-uknaid, a-ibagi be gunnoed. Banedga, we-ibmar be sabogosulid. Ani an Bab-Jehová gued.
”An-igarmar-mamaidba be ibsamala, eba be ibmar-imakdii gumala. Ani an Bab-Jehová gued.
”An-nug-islidikidgi melle be dodomalo, adi, Israel-dulemar-abargi an-nug islidik guegar. Ani an Bab-Jehová bemar islidik imaked.
Ani an Egipto-yargi bemar-onosad, adi, an bemar-Bab-Dummadga gumalagar. Ani an Bab-Jehová gued.”
